pr_body:
**PR Title**

Use `SslApplicationProtocol.Http3`

**PR Description**

Use the new `SslApplicationProtocol.Http3` field where relevant.

Fixes #36668.

issue_context.title: Use SslApplicationProtocol.Http3 constant

SslApplicationProtocol.Http3 was added in RC1 so we can replace a few usages of "h3".

review_comments: The first commit had some random flaky test failure. I had a quick look at why it failed and couldn't fathom why (didn't seem related to my change either), but while I was looking I noticed that those two tests weren't asserting that this step was actually succeeding.
